name: after-school clubs
pitch: Find local after-school clubs that finish at 6 pm for a seven-year-old.
instructions: Search for after-school clubs in the person's area that end at 6 pm. Open each result in the browser. Read the page to check the finish time and age range. If the page does not say, open the next result. When three suitable clubs are found, stop. If fewer than three are found after checking five results, say how many were found and that more may exist. Show the person a comparison table with the club name, location, finish time, age range, and a link to the page.
starters: clubs that end at 6 pm for a 7-year-old

examples.ask: find after-school clubs for a seven-year-old that run until six pm
examples.does: Search the web, check finish times, and show a comparison table.

readme:
# after-school clubs
Find local after-school clubs that finish at 6 pm for a seven-year-old.

What it does: searches the web for clubs, checks their finish times and age ranges, and presents a comparison table.

What it needs: web search and browser tools.

What it will not do: it cannot book a place, it cannot guarantee availability, and it cannot give prices unless clearly stated on the page.
